target: forge.sh — a token containing a double quote is refused before any request (pr-state UNKNOWN, check fails naming the token); control: a safe token reaches the API
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
export FORGE_TOKEN='glpat-FAKE"x'
fx_run pr-state "$U"; fx_show bad
echo "bad_requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_run check; echo "check_rc=$FX_RC"; printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | sed 's/^/chk: /'
if printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -E '^fail' | grep -qi 'token'; then echo check-fail-names-token=yes; else echo check-fail-names-token=no; fi
echo "check_requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_reqs_clear
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_run pr-state "$U"; fx_show ctl
echo "ctl_requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
